text: Virtual reality (VR)-based stress paradigms are increasingly used to induce stress in controlled yet ecologically valid settings. However, the diversity of VR-based stress paradigms and their differential engagement of stress-response systems remain insufficiently synthesized. This scoping review aimed to map VR stress paradigms and examine how they engage subjective, autonomic, endocrine, neural, and behavioral responses, while considering the role of early adversity.
source_label: Virtual reality-based stress paradigms and early adversity: a scoping review of mechanisms and stress-response systems
